assertionResults.reason: The repo-local hack runtime started the declared `web` and `auth-broker` services, `hack ps --json` showed both containers running, `hack open --json` returned `https://hack-cli.hack`, and routed health checks succeeded for `https://auth.hack-cli.hack/health`.

The broker `GET /v1/auth/providers` and web `GET /api/auth/providers` endpoints returned the same Better Auth provider contract: enabled state `true`, the same GitHub social provider, identical trusted origins, and matching account-linking policy.

A broker session-start flow preserved the trusted redirect `https://hack-cli.hack/auth/account` in the returned authorize URL, while the untrusted redirect `https://example.com/evil` was stripped from the authorize URL entirely. The web social-start route also returned a provider URL while keeping broker-trusted origins authoritative.

The broker legacy HTML entrypoints no longer own the auth UX: visiting `https://auth.hack-cli.hack/auth` and `/auth/account` ended at `https://hack-cli.hack/auth...`, browser screenshots showed the sign-in and account pages in `apps/web`, and the bridged account flow produced a management token that authenticated `GET /v1/auth/me`.

The repo root workspace graph includes `apps/*`, `apps/web/package.json` declares `@hack/web`, `bunx turbo run typecheck --filter=@hack/web` executed successfully through Turbo, and the app booted on the hack-managed routed host `https://hack-cli.hack`.

The browser-visible shell exposed a skip link and keyboard navigation targets in the snapshot, annotated screenshots showed semantic shell sections and auth entrypoints, a reduced-motion screenshot was captured after forcing reduced motion, and browser console errors remained empty.

frictions: The prescribed `user-testing-flow-validator` Task subagent is unavailable in this environment (`Droid configuration not found`), so the flow report was written manually after running the real user-surface checks directly.

commands.observation: Started the hack-managed stack with `web` and `auth-broker` services.
Reported both `auth-broker` and `web` running and exposed `https://hack-cli.hack` as the routed app URL.
Confirmed broker health and fetched matching broker/web Better Auth metadata payloads.
The trusted redirect stayed in the returned authorize URL while the untrusted redirect was stripped.
The web auth start route returned a provider URL for both happy-path and untrusted-redirect requests while deferring trust decisions to broker metadata.
Captured annotated screenshots for the shell, sign-in page, redirected broker auth page, account page, and reduced-motion shell view.
Focused milestone suites passed 86 tests covering auth entrypoints, handoff helpers, provider parity, trusted origin handling, redirects, and org/team route contracts.
Turbo resolved `@hack/web` in the workspace graph and completed typecheck successfully.
The full `apps/web` package suite passed 13 tests, including the clean-checkout safety check, auth entrypoints, handoff helpers, and accessible shell coverage.
